name: Galaxy A51

Body.Other: Optical fingerprint sensor (in display), accelerometer, gyro, proximity, compass

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 10 with One UI 2.0, Current: Android 13 with One UI 5.1
Platform.CPU: Octa-core, 4G: 4x2.3 GHz Cortex-A73 & 4x1.7 GHz Cortex-A53, 5G (International): 2x2.2 GHz Cortex-A77 & 6x1.8 GHz Cortex-A55, 5G (Japan)/5G UW: 1x2.4 GHz Kryo 475 Prime & 1x2.2 GHz Kryo 475 Gold & 6x1.8 GHz Kryo 475 Silver
Platform.GPU: 4G: Mali-G72 MP3, 5G (International): Mali-G76 MP5, 5G (Japan)/5G UW: Adreno 620

Memory.RAM: 4G: 4, 6, or 8 GB RAM, 5G: 6 or 8 GB RAM
Memory.Card slot: microSDXC, 4G: Expandable up to 512 GB, 5G: Expandable up to 1 TB

Display.Display: 6.5 in Super AMOLED FHD+ 1080 x 2400 pixels, 20:9 ratio (~405 ppi density)

Cameras.Rear camera: 48 Megapixel, MP, f/2.0, 26mm (wide), 1/2.0", 0.8μm, Phase detection autofocus, PDAF, 12 Megapixel, MP, f/2.2, 123° (ultrawide), 5 Megapixel, MP, f/2.4, (macro), 5 Megapixel, MP, f/2.4, (depth), LED flash, panorama, HDR, 4K resolution, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/120fps; gyro-EIS

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Wi-Fi hotspot, Bluetooth 5.0, FeliCa (Japanese models only)
